class.name: FlowSubgraphNode
class.brief_description: Runs another [FlowGraph] from its start node and continues when it ends.
class.description: The subgraph node reuses a graph inside another graph. It has the flow input [code]in[/code] and the flow output [code]out[/code]. When the execution reaches it, the graph in [member graph] runs from its start node; when that graph reaches a [FlowEndNode], the execution continues at [code]out[/code]. How the ends of the inner graph map to the outputs of the node is part of the playback. A missing graph is a configuration warning. Its runtime behavior comes with the playback, which is a later feature; until then the node only has its properties and ports. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var subgraph := FlowSubgraphNode.new() subgraph.graph = preload("res://graphs/shop.tres") graph.add_node(subgraph) [/gdscript] [csharp] var subgraph = new FlowSubgraphNode { Graph = GD.Load<FlowGraph>("res://graphs/shop.tres") }; graph.AddNode(subgraph); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

members.member: The graph to run. It is a separate resource and keeps its own nodes, variables and start node.
